tests.report:
Feature: Start without any stop is refused
Expected: The control does not start: the status badge still shows 'Gestoppt' and the Start button is still shown, and the message 'Bitte mindestens eine Haltestelle wählen' appears (it may disappear again after a few seconds)
Observed failure: After 'Alle Strecken zurücksetzen' and clicking Start, the start was refused (badge stayed 'Gestoppt', Start button still shown, speed 0), but the message 'Bitte mindestens eine Haltestelle wählen' (or equivalent) did not appear in the snapshot taken immediately after the click; status region empty, no alert/toast. Same on a second click.
Steps completed before failure: 5

Feature: The trains run around the loop in opposite directions
Expected: Comparing consecutive screenshots, the marker of 'Bahn 1' moves clockwise along the main loop and the marker of 'Bahn 2' moves counter-clockwise; the two trains do not circle the loop in the same sense
Observed failure: Bahn 1 was seen moving clockwise around the main loop (top straight left-to-right, right curve down, bottom straight right-to-left, left curve up). Bahn 2 was never seen moving counter-clockwise on the main loop across the 5 screenshots: it was on the right curve below Haltestelle 2, then moved down/left to Weiche 3 (clockwise sense, during 'Bahn 2 weicht aus'), then on the siding / at the calibration point ('Bahn 2 wird kalibriert'), then standing at Weiche 3 with speed 0 ('Bahn 2 wartet'). Bahn 2's counter-clockwise motion could not be observed.
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Locomotive server becomes reachable again
Expected: The mock console shows at least 1 connected client for 'Bahn 2', and the app shows the connection to 'Bahn 2' again without an error message about 'Bahn 2'
Observed failure: After 'Take Bahn 2 offline' the app correctly showed 'Der Server „Bahn 2“ ist nicht erreichbar.'. After 'Bring Bahn 2 online' and waiting 15 s, the mock console showed Bahn 2 'Online' but 'Connected clients: 0' (Bahn 1: 1), i.e. the backend had not reconnected to Bahn 2. After reopening the app URL, Bahn 2 showed 'Verbindung: Verbunden' with no error alert, so the app half was met but the console condition (>= 1 connected client for Bahn 2 after 15 s) was not.
Steps completed before failure: 11
